cases.script:
strip() { /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' "$1" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'; }
show() { printf '%s status=%s out=' "$1" "$2"; /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|' < /tmp/rf.out; printf ' err='; strip /tmp/rf.err; echo; }

cases.purpose: finfo's summary for /dev/null, /dev/zero, the guest block device and root-created synthetic nodes (c 4095:1048575, b 300:70000, c 256:256, b 7:200): the "Device (major/minor)", "Mode: (octal) S_IF*" and "Device type" lines, checked on the reference side against values rebuilt from GNU stat %Hr/%Lr/%f/%F with glibc makedev and int truncation; nodes are removed afterwards.
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils 9.7 stat with the documented makedev encoding (reference-side emulation)
cases.comparison: Byte parity of stdout and status: the candidate's summary is filtered to the three lines (the mode line up to its S_IF token); the reference prints the same lines from stat. The final listing shows the nodes removed.
cases.script:
if ! builtin type finfo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # Reference: the three device lines of finfo's summary, rebuilt from GNU stat.
  finfo() { local p=$1 ma mi d f t
    read -r ma mi f t < <(/usr/bin/stat -c '%Hr %Lr %f %F' -- "$p") || return 1
    d=$(( ((ma & 0xfff) << 8) | (mi & 0xff) | ((mi & ~0xff) << 12) | ((ma & ~0xfff) << 32) ))
    d=$(( d & 0xffffffff )); (( d >= 2147483648 )) && d=$(( d - 4294967296 ))
    case $t in 'character special file') t=S_IFCHR;; 'block special file') t=S_IFBLK;; 'regular empty file'|'regular file') t=S_IFREG;; *) t=?;; esac
    printf 'Device (major/minor): %d (%d/%d)\nMode: (%o) %s\nDevice type: %d\n' "$d" "$ma" "$mi" "0x$f" "$t" "$d"; }
  pick() { finfo "$1"; }
else
  pick() { finfo "$1" | /usr/bin/sed -nE 's/^(Device \(major\/minor\): .*|Device type: .*)$/\1/p; s/^(Mode: \([0-7]+\) S_IF[A-Z]+) .*/\1/p'; }
fi
/usr/bin/mknod c1 c 4095 1048575; /usr/bin/mknod b1 b 300 70000; /usr/bin/mknod c2 c 256 256; /usr/bin/mknod b2 b 7 200
blk=$(for x in /dev/vda /dev/sda /dev/nvme0n1; do [[ -b $x ]] && { echo $x; break; }; done)
for p in /dev/null /dev/zero $blk c1 b1 c2 b2; do echo "== $p"; pick $p; echo "status=$?"; done
/usr/bin/rm c1 b1 c2 b2; echo "left: $(/usr/bin/ls)"

files.tarhdr.py:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Independent ustar header reader: name, typeflag, devmajor, devminor per member.
import sys
data = open(sys.argv[1], 'rb').read()
off = 0
while off + 512 <= len(data):
    h = data[off:off + 512]
    if h == bytes(512):
        break
    name = h[0:100].rstrip(b'\0').decode()
    prefix = h[345:500].rstrip(b'\0').decode() if h[257:262] == b'ustar' else ''
    size = int(h[124:136].rstrip(b'\0 ').decode() or '0', 8)
    tf = chr(h[156]) if h[156] else '0'
    num = lambda b: int(b.rstrip(b'\0 ').decode() or '0', 8)
    if tf not in 'xgL':
        print('  member %s type=%s dev=%d,%d' % ((prefix + '/' if prefix else '') + name, tf, num(h[329:337]), num(h[337:345])))
    off += 512 + (size + 511) // 512 * 512
files.gentar.py:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Independently generated archive with character and block device members.
import tarfile, sys
with tarfile.open(sys.argv[1], 'w', format=tarfile.USTAR_FORMAT) as t:
    for name, kind, ma, mi in (('dev/cdev', tarfile.CHRTYPE, 1, 3), ('dev/bdev', tarfile.BLKTYPE, 7, 200), ('dev/big', tarfile.CHRTYPE, 4095, 1048575)):
        i = tarfile.TarInfo(name); i.type = kind; i.devmajor = ma; i.devminor = mi
        i.mode = 0o640; i.mtime = 1700000000; i.uid = i.gid = 0; i.uname = i.gname = 'root'
        t.addfile(i)
